newsitem.title: USA: TransTexas Gas tests Fandango well.
newsitem.headline: TransTexas Gas tests Fandango well.

text.p: TransTexas Gas Corp said on Tuesday that its Lauro Lopez #3 well flowed at a rate of 28.4 million cubic feet of natural gas per day on a 28/64-inch choke with flowing tubing pressure of 4,840 pounds per square inch.
The well is the second in the Fandango South natural gas field, TransTexas said.

Also, TransTexas said it has drilled what it believes is its twelfth discovery outside the Lobo Trend with the Cuellar Estate #1 in eastern Zapata County, Texas. The well was drilled to 13,827 feet after which electric logs indicated the presence of 120 feet pay in the Upper Wilcox, the company said.
